Tens of thousands protest against Narendra Modi regime in Delhi

candidate_claims.text: Photograph: Vipin/AP Tens of thousands protest against Narendra Modi regime in Delhi Led by Congress party, India’s opposition alliance channels anger over removal of 130 million names from voter roll Thousands of opposition supporters have gathered in Delhi as protests against the Narendra Modi government continue to gather momentum.

Led by the Congress party, India’s opposition alliance has brought together supporters from across the country, amid growing anger over a large-scale revision of the country’s voter roll that has seen 130 million names erased.

Photograph: Bhawika Chhabra/Reuters The protest was one of the largest shows of opposition strength in years, taking place amid a wider resurgence of anti-government dissent which has been systematically crushed over the 12 years of the Modi regime.

I’m not particularly for any opposition party.” She said many questions still remained about the viability and support of that opposition, but she sensed a “groundswell of dissatisfaction with the BJP and the opposition is cashing in on it – good for them”.

items.title: PM’s speech during Rashtriya Ekta Diwas

candidate_claims.text: गर्व इस महान राष्ट्र के नागरिक होने का और कृतज्ञता सरदार वल्लभ भाई पटेल के प्रति, जिन्होंने आजादी के बाद 550 से ज्यादा रियासतों को एक किया।
गणतंत्र हमें उन फैसलों को संविधान की मर्यादा में आगे बढ़ाने का मार्ग दिखाता है, संविधान हमें जनता के प्रति जवाबदेह रखता है, और एकता हमें एक राष्ट्र के रूप में आगे बढ़ने की शक्ति देती है।
साथियों, इस वर्ष उस महान कार्य को भी 75 वर्ष पूरे हुए हैं।
साथियों, सरदार पटेल के 150वें जन्मदिवस पर, मैंने यहीं उनके चरणों में खड़े होकर कहा था, “जब तक, जब तक देश नक्सलवाद, माओवादी आतंक से पूरी तरह मुक्त नहीं हो जाता, हम चैन से बैठने वाले नहीं हैं”।
2015 में देश के एक सौ छब्बीस जिले वामपंथी उग्रवाद से प्रभावित थे।
मार्च 2026 तक देश में ऐसा कोई जिला नहीं रह गया, जो अब भी नक्सलवाद से प्रभावित हो।
मैं आज उन सभी वीर जवानों को भी नमन करता हूँ, जिन्होंने देश के इन क्षेत्रों में शांति स्थापित करने के लिए सर्वोच्च बलिदान दिया।
साथियों, आज भारत पहले से अधिक सुरक्षित है, आज भारत अधिक संकल्पित है, और इसका एक बड़ा कारण, देशवासियों का बढ़ा हुआ आत्मविश्वास है।
ये रिपोर्ट बताती है कि 2024 से पहले के 10-12 वर्षों में, 50 करोड़ भारतीयों ने गरीबी को परास्त किया है।
यानी पहले जहाँ 100 में से 27 लोग, एक चौथाई से भी ज्यादा, 100 में से 27 लोग भीषण गरीबी की चपेट में थे, आज ये संख्या कम होते होते 100 में सिर्फ 3 से भी कम रह गई है।
ये सब इसलिए हुआ, क्योंकि पिछले 12 वर्षों से देश, गरीब कल्याण, गरीबों को सशक्त करने को प्राथमिकता दे रहा है।
इन 12 वर्षों में, देश को लीकेज फ्री व्यवस्था मिली।
करोड़ों लोगों को बीमा की सुरक्षा मिली, जिसने संकट के समय करोड़ों भारतीयों को संबल दिया।
2014 से पहले देश में 25 करोड़ लोगों के पास भी सामाजिक सुरक्षा कवच नहीं था।
आज देश के करीब 100 करोड़ लोगों को सामाजिक सुरक्षा कवच से जोड़ा जा चुका है।
ऐसे ही प्रयासों से हम देश में गरीबी दूर करके रहेंगे, देश को विकसित भारत बनाएंगे।
एक दशक से अधिक की हताशा और निराशा के कारण, ये लोग अब खुलकर सामने आ गए हैं।
हमने सुदूर इलाकों में नक्सलवाद का अंत कर दिया है।
2047 तक जब आजादी के 100 साल होंगे, 2047 तक सशक्त और समर्थ विकसित भारत का निर्माण!

candidate_promises.text: इस दिशा में हमें अब अगले बड़े लक्ष्यों पर काम करना है।
‘एक भारत, श्रेष्ठ भारत’ का मंत्र और, विकसित भारत का लक्ष्य, अब ये भारत के अटल संकल्प बन चुके हैं।

items.title: PM’s speech at the launch of development projects in Banaskantha, Gujarat

candidate_claims.text: Today, through technology, farmers from every district of the country are connected with us.
Today, through technology, farmers from every village of Gujarat are connected with us.
Today, Banaskantha has established its stature.
Had you informed the Guinness Book of World Records in advance, they would certainly have recorded it as a world record.
The responsibility that you entrusted to me has now completed twenty-five years.
Let me remind you that after becoming Chief Minister in 2001, my first major public programme as Chief Minister was held in Deesa.
I do not believe that record has been broken to this day.
That record belongs to Banaskantha.
Only a few days after Navratri, I have received the opportunity to come to the sacred land of Mother Amba.
Friends, The people of Gujarat and Banaskantha should forgive me, but I have to speak in Hindi today because people from all over the country are connected with this programme.
candidate_claims.context_before: I extend my heartfelt congratulations to the people of Gujarat, to the people of the country, and to farmers across India.

candidate_claims.text: Compared to 2013–14, the agricultural budget of the country has now increased more than five times.
Today, more than ₹18,000 crore has been transferred into the accounts of nearly ten crore farmers.
More than fifty lakh farmers of Gujarat have also benefited from it.
More than ₹1,000 crore has been deposited into their accounts.
In Banaskantha alone, nearly ₹50 crore has reached the accounts of lakhs of farming families.
Friends, Because of our government’s policies over the past years, farmers have received benefits or savings worth more than ₹50 lakh crore.
Around ₹4.5 lakh crore under PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi has directly reached the bank accounts of small farmers.
Yet small farmers account for more than 85 percent of all farmers in our country.
The government spent nearly ₹16 lakh crore on this.
To ensure that fertilisers remain affordable for you, we had to spend ₹16 lakh crore from the national treasury, so that the burden would not fall upon our farmers.
Over the past twelve years, farmers growing wheat and paddy have received ₹24 lakh crore in MSP payments directly into their accounts.
Friends, Our government has provided farmers with a powerful safety net through the PM Fasal Bima Yojana.
We launched crop insurance on a large scale.
During the past ten to twelve years, farmers have received more than ₹2 lakh crore in crop insurance compensation.
Whenever crops suffered losses, over ₹2 lakh crore reached farmers through insurance support.

items.title: PM’s address during inauguration of the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026

candidate_claims.text: But today, 21st-century India is moving ahead with a new mindset and a new confidence.
When many countries around the world were struggling with vaccine availability, India developed its own vaccine, carried out vaccination on a large scale, and also supplied vaccines to other nations.
This is the confidence of 21st-century India.
On 30th October, the nation will celebrate the birth anniversary of Dr.
Just a few months ago, the country’s 500-Megawatt Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor achieved First Criticality.
This year, India achieved new milestones in the space sector as well.
India also achieved the capability of satellite docking.
This very year, India hosted the AI Impact Summit and launched its own AI model.
Whenever a solution succeeds in India, it creates pathways for solving the problems of many countries around the world.
Our 5G technology is another example.
This Brain Centre is working on developing high-resolution digital 3D images of the human brain.
In the past year, nearly twelve thousand crore rupees have already been committed to technologies that are ready to move from the laboratory to the market.
Last year, this number rose to nearly one hundred and fifty thousand.
Friends, In this second quarter of the 21st century, another question has become extremely important.
A scientist questions established patterns.
For this purpose, several National Missions have also been launched.

candidate_promises.text: Now our goal is to create new technologies for India, for the world, for today, and for the future, to determine their direction, and to develop the capability to provide solutions to global challenges.
Friends, All of you know that for building a Developed India, we will require nuclear energy on a large scale.
Our goal is to develop technologies that strengthen India while also contributing solutions to the challenges facing humanity.
Our spirit should be: We will do it.
Our confidence should be: We will do it.

items.title: PM’s address during inauguration key RBI facilities in Bhubaneswar

candidate_claims.text: Friends, After independence, large cities were developed in the country, grand institutions were established, large hospitals were built, and massive airports were constructed.
Medical colleges are being opened in smaller towns.
Nearly 1.75 lakh Ayushman Arogya Mandirs have been established in villages.
In the 1960s and 70s, banks were nationalised in the name of the poor.
Yet, until 2014, more than half of the country’s population was excluded from the banking ecosystem.
Today, digital banking in India has connected everyone to 24-hour financial services.
But prior to 2014, there was an entirely different era of ‘phone banking’.
A select few in Delhi and those connected with influential circles were granted loans worth thousands of crores through phone calls.
The frameworks built by the nation in recent years, along with the new ecosystem developed under Digital India, have extended banking to every single citizen.
Friends, It was from this very land of Odisha that a former Prime Minister of the country once stated that when one rupee is sent from Delhi, only 15 paise reaches the people.
As Nirmala ji mentioned just now, this has been made possible solely because of the approximately 59 to 60 crore Jan Dhan accounts opened in the country.
From small entrepreneurs to traditional artisans, from street vendors to workers in the unorganised sector, they have received the benefits of formal banking for the first time.
Through the Mudra Yojana, 13 crore people have become first-time entrepreneurs.
PM SVANidhi has provided loans to lakhs of street vendors for the first time.
The PM Vishwakarma scheme has connected lakhs of skilled craftspersons with banks.
Banks have also extended assistance worth thousands of crores of rupees to self-help groups comprising 10 crore rural women.
All of this has been achieved through your collective cooperation.
Through the Atal Pension Yojana, 9 crore people have received social security coverage, with 38 lakh individuals covered in Odisha alone.
About 10 to 12 years ago, insurance was considered a luxury; the poor and middle class could hardly contemplate it.
At a nominal premium of just ₹20 per year, an insurance coverage of up to ₹2 lakh is being provided.
Similarly, for life insurance, we introduced the PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana, available at an annual premium of less than ₹450.
To date, claims exceeding ₹25,000 crore have been disbursed to the public.
If any other government had announced the distribution of ₹25,000 crore, it would have generated massive headlines, accompanied by celebrations and fanfares for months.

candidate_promises.text: Our goal is to extend better connectivity to far-flung areas, provide facilities for underprivileged families to live with dignity, and continually instill confidence in every citizen that they will not be left behind in the journey of development.
We will do it; we are determined to accomplish this.

items.title: PM’s address at the inauguration of Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan

candidate_claims.text: Because the Chinmaya Mission is not merely an institution; it is a Chinmaya ideal, which was established by a Chinmaya Rishi.
The darshan of Pujya Gurudev Swami Chinmayananda ji in this form, the privilege of conversing with his holobot, made it feel as though I had travelled 33 years back in time.
My meeting with Gurudev in Vadodara in 1993, the conversation with him, his affection, his blessings – today everything reappeared before my eyes once again.
Friends, Around February-March in 1993, I met Pujya Gurudev; I had gone to invite him to the centenary celebrations of the Parliament of the World’s Religions in Chicago, USA.

When the Parliament of Religions took place in Chicago on 11 September, fortunately, I was there.
Since then until today, for the past 25 years, as the head of the government, I have been continuously serving the nation to the best of my ability; Guruji’s blessings are with me.
Many of our young companions undertook a journey of 40,000 kilometres over nearly 300 days.
During this period, more than one lakh youths were contacted.

Therefore, friends, When the occasion of 75 years of the country’s independence arrived, the thought came to my mind that we must not only turn this occasion into an inspirational platform for a developed India, but we must also revive that essence of India which knows how to live with immortal ideas, and which, through its experience of thousands of centuries, can care for humanity across eras.
With as much devotion as he spoke on spiritual matters, with equal promptness he delivered articulate discourses on national issues.
In 2015, I had the privilege of releasing a special commemorative coin in his memory.
His radio programme named ‘Art of Man Making’ provided direction to countless individuals.
That is why today we see that more than 100 educational institutions of Chinmaya Mission are shaping the future of lakhs of children and youth.

Over the past 12 years, we have brought back more than six hundred and fifty such stolen ancient statues.
Friends, In 2047, when India completes 100 years of its independence, around that very period, Chinmaya Mission will also celebrate its centenary year.

items.title: PM’s address in NDTV World Summit

candidate_claims.text: Nowadays, everyone is talking about a new world order.
Friends When talking about ‘The World Between Orders’, we need to understand two things.
And countries that were not at the table when the global order was initially established came forward with their own prominent roles.

For decades, trade connected nations, technology closed distances, maritime routes linked economies, and culture and mobility brought diverse societies closer together; but today, these very links face fresh strains.
Therefore, the challenge today is not merely about the emergence of a new global order.
Friends, Before elaborating on India’s role, I will take you back by 7 to 8 years.
Those who made grand proclamations about globalization prioritized their own self-interests in a time of crisis.

In that era of fragmentation, everyone viewed each other with suspicion, and global trust had hit rock bottom; it was then, in 2020, from the G20 platform, that I placed an idea before the world, calling for “a new world order for the collective well-being of humankind” – an order with humanity at its very core.
When capable nations were thinking solely of themselves, India stepped forward, delivered vaccines to every needy nation, and dispatched medicines to over 100 countries.
But India built bridges, emphasized dialogue, and on both occasions, the Delhi Declaration was adopted through unanimous consensus.
Friends, India is working with all its might to become a top-3 economy.
Our confidence grows even further when we look at the present difficult global circumstances, in the midst of which India continues to emerge as the fastest-growing major economy.
India is one of the largest digital economies.
India stands number one in real-time digital payments.
Friends, Today’s India is expanding its capabilities across various sectors, and there are numerous milestones achieved for the first time in the country.
India’s Fast Breeder Reactor achieved criticality for the first time.
During this period, India’s first hydrogen train began operations, and India crossed the 300-gigawatt mark in non-fossil electricity capacity for the first time.
India won 85 medals this time, achieving many milestones for the first time.
Look around today: India’s exports are setting new records.
Speaking of September alone, exports of goods and products increased by nearly 25 percent compared to last year.
Seafood exports have more than doubled in the last 12 years.
In our villages, more than 3.5 crore women have become Lakhpati Didis, and we are working toward the goal of creating 6 crore Lakhpati Didis.
Under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana, around 70 lakh new jobs have been created in a very short span of time.
For the middle class, income tax has been made zero up to 12 lakh rupees – this needs to be reminded to you again and again; it cannot be that you simply take what you get and forget it.
In the year 2025, nearly 1.5 lakh patents were filed – 1.5 lakh patents in a single year.

candidate_promises.text: Therefore, a single spirit resonates across India today, and that spirit is: ‘We Will Do It, We Will Do It.’ We will dream big, turn every challenge into an opportunity, and translate every resolution into reality.
We will innovate, forge new paths, reach new heights, and link India’s success with the world’s success.

Our growing economic strength has created new opportunities for the India-Poland partnership.
We have established an Indian Studies Chair in the city of Kraków.

candidate_claims.text: Friends, You have given 1.4 billion countrymen an opportunity to feel proud.
You have enhanced the pride of the Tiranga, you have increased its honour.
And especially our women’s hockey team, you ended a long wait of 44 years by bringing home the gold medal.
In cricket, both our teams won medals for the second consecutive time and, in fact, repeated their own record.

Outstanding performances in shooting, major successes in boxing and wrestling, new records in athletics, a medal in weightlifting after twenty-eight years, and India’s success in marathon events for the first time since 1982.
Out of the 85 medals won by India, 38 medals were won by our women athletes.
Among them were 11 gold medals as well.
In Mixed Martial Arts, Soft Tennis, and certain sailing events, our players created new history by winning medals for the first time.
Friends, Over the past 12 years, India too has worked with great patience and dedication on its sportspersons and its sports ecosystem.
There used to be huge events such as the Olympics, yet India had no representation in more than half of the sports.
Over the past 10–12 years, the country worked continuously with dedication and sincerity, pursued a long-term vision, and built a transparent and modern ecosystem for sports.
As all of you know, we launched the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS).
We launched the Khelo India Scheme.
As Mansukh Bhai mentioned earlier, more than ₹36,000 crore has been allocated for expanding Khelo India and strengthening sports federations.
Friends, Today, more than one thousand Khelo India Centres have been established across the country.
Stadiums, mini-stadiums, and multi-purpose sports halls have been created.
Athletics tracks, football grounds, hockey grounds, swimming pools, and thousands of such sports infrastructures are being built in both small and large cities.
Under this scheme, direct assistance is being provided to athletes as well.

The country created a new Sports Policy and a new Khelo Bharat Policy.
Friends, This time, many players in Team India at the Asian Games were only 15 to 17 years old.
In fact, in sports, starting young is an added advantage.
The Los Angeles Olympics will take place in 2028.
India will host the Commonwealth Games in 2030.

The honour of the Tiranga on every field, We will Do it!
A new identity for India in sports, We will Do it!
New champions in every sport, We will Do it!
More records in our name, We will Do it!

Major sporting events in India, We will Do it!

India among the top sporting nations, We will Do it!
India as a global sports hub, We will Do it!

You already know that whenever I meet foreign guests, I often present products made in Ladakh as gifts and also tell them about all of you.
